outcome: Time to first use of modern contraception
cohort: 1003 postpartum women in the Mfantseman Municipality of Ghana
finding: Postpartum contraceptive use was low, with many women not protected against pregnancy, and factors like occupation, area of residence, mode of delivery, breastfeeding, time since delivery, preferred number of children, and parity predicted contraceptive use.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant predictor of postpartum contraceptive use.
